translations.web: All your children will be taught by Yahweh; and your children’s peace will be great.
translations.bsb: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
translations.kjv: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
translations.asv: And all thy children shall be taught of Jehovah; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
